summary.intent: Fix a regression found in review on PR #637 (trail #462): a temporary cascade raise could become self-sustaining through a linked group with an exact-pin addon. Write a failing test first, then apply a minimal reachability-prune fix to the fixed-point solver, and push to the PR branch.
summary.outcome: Wrote the regression test (fails on PR branch, passes on main's solver), implemented the reachability prune in cascade.rs, updated two existing tests and the termination bound (now 4p+2), and got cascade tests, lint and mutants (16 viable all caught) passing. The signed commit was made after a format fix, but merging origin/main, pushing, ls-remote confirmation, PR body update, finding resolution and the report to the lead are not shown as done.

repo: Pre-commit hook enforces formatting; commit fails until cargo fmt is run, so format before committing.
cargo mutants runs can leave a proptest regression file that must be checked against real code and removed, never committed.
The termination bound for the cascade fixed-point solver is documented and tested; the prune changed it to 4p+2, so the PR body needs the updated argument.

code.finding: late_realigned_fixed_pair helper was extended with an optional linked `addon` (exact pin to app@0.1.0) so existing call sites stay unchanged while the new regression is covered.

Reachability prune before accepting a fixed point drops raises not reachable from an explicit seed via active edges; this made the old keep-phase test's stale `app` raise correctly pruned and changed the bound test.

workflow: Verify a regression test fails on the PR branch and passes on origin/main's solver before fixing.
Use --no-fail-fast when running crate tests so sandbox-induced unrelated failures don't hide the rest.

Sandbox blocks network (registry.npmjs.org) and writes to ~/.npm, causing unrelated callisto-graph test failures that CI covers; gh/entire CLI calls needed to run outside the sandbox due to TLS verification failures.

friction: TLS verification failed inside the sandbox when reading the entire trail finding; had to rerun outside the sandbox.
Sandbox network block on registry.npmjs.org and ~/.npm write block caused unrelated callisto-graph test failures.
Pre-commit format check failed on first commit, requiring a format and recommit.
Lint required a follow-up change (factoring a return type) after the first run.
open_items: Merge latest origin/main, push with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wp-cascade-fixpoint, and confirm with git ls-remote.
Update the PR #637 body with the new termination argument (bound 4p+2) via gh pr edit --body-file.
Resolve finding 01M84PQDCV8TVP1NY6CTXHK1Z0 with entire trail finding resolve --trail 462.
Report to the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) in under 5 lines: PR, sha, what was run.
The two npm-related callisto-graph test failures were not verified locally; rely on GitHub CI.
